# [Virtualmin Nginx and Virtualmin Nginx SSL modules 3.1.0 released](https://forum.virtualmin.com/t/virtualmin-nginx-and-virtualmin-nginx-ssl-modules-3-1-0-released/137897)


[News](https://forum.virtualmin.com/c/news/5)


[Ilia](https://forum.virtualmin.com/u/Ilia)


September 1, 2026, 6:25pm 1


Howdy,


We’ve rolled out version 3.1.0 of the Virtualmin Nginx and Virtualmin Nginx SSL modules to all repos.


Changes since the last release:


- Add HTTP/3 support for SSL-enabled domains
- Add support for IPv6-only domains and improved listener handling during IP changes and restores
- Add filename and query-string options for Nginx redirects
- Fix Nginx directory alias handling
- Fix redirects that exclude` .well-known` paths
- Fix` X-Forwarded-Proto` for proxy backends
- Fix SSL certificate chain synchronization


---


As always, if you run into any problems, let us know in a *new* topic.
